beats.say: Shrek 2 Remastered was just revealed with a surprise GTA parody trailer.
According to IGN, the remake's official reveal trailer directly parodied GTA 6.
The classic adventure originally released back in 2004.
IGN reports fans are already reacting strongly to the game's surprising PC requirements.
Nobody expected a 2004 movie game to demand modern PC hardware.
Will you be playing Shrek 2 Remastered on PC?
